text:
mira: Heads-up — started seeing a batch of GPU nodes in eu-west-2 marked offline after the OOB firmware push last night. Provisioning is queueing and several jobs are failing allocation.

alex: which firmware exactly? OOB job shows v1.4.2-rc3 landed at 02:12 UTC.

mira: yes that's the one. Symptoms: BMC reports repeated thermal alarm, fan RPM spikes to 100%, then the BMCS goes into maintenance state and the node is soft-offlined by the provisioning controller. No kernel panic on the host — the nodes are unreachable via IPMI.

sam: saw similar in the logs: ops-bot forwarded this excerpt:

ops-bot: "2026-03-17T02:14:08Z BMC[fw-v1.4.2-rc3] fanctl: RPM surged 14k -> override engage -> thermal_lockdown=true
2026-03-17T02:14:09Z BMC[fw-v1.4.2-rc3] smm_watchdog: triggered, setting service-mode
2026-03-17T02:14:10Z Provisioner: marking node gpu-eu2-123 offline (maintenance)" 

john: any correlation with BIOS microcode? We did a staggered BIOS update two nights ago for the same batch — maybe an interaction.

mira: good catch. The affected hosts are all on BIOS rev 6.1.0 + microcode bundle 2026-02. When combined with this BMC build, the fan controller calibration seems to misread the tachometer for PCIe NIC airflow direction.

lei: we also saw one node toggle secure boot from "disabled" -> "enabled" while it went into maintenance, which caused ASH image verification to fail on next reprovision attempt. That slowed recovery.

alex: that's nasty. So two failure modes: OOB fan/thermal triggers causing soft-offline, and an intermittent secure-boot flag flip preventing reprovisioning. Estimated impact: 18 GPUs out of eu-west pool (approx 6% of capacity), plus a few nodes stuck in reprovision loop.

sam: immediate mitigation options?

mira: rolling back BMC to v1.4.1 on the remaining canaries is safest; also patch the provisioning controller to ignore transient secure-boot toggles for 10 minutes during maintenance to avoid failed reprovisioning. I'll open a canary rollback run.

alex: agree. Can we also temporarily drain affected host allocation to other regions? We have spare in eu-central but cross-region allocation raises cost — booking extra spot capacity will increase monthly run rate by an estimated $7k if sustained.

john: schedule: mira/ops run rollback now, sam can patch the controller, alex coordinate cross-region capacity with cost lead. I'll update the incident board.

mira: rollout command (what I'm running):

```
# rollback BMC on eu-west canaries
oobctl firmware install --target gpu-eu2-canary-01 --image bmc-v1.4.1 --force
provisioner mark-canary --region eu-west-2 --tag bmc-rollback-in-progress
```

sam: patch diff for controller (short):

```
- if node.secure_boot != expected: fail_provision()
+ if node.secure_boot != expected and time_since_maintenance_start > 10m: fail_provision()
```

lei: I've started a repro on a spare rack with v1.4.2-rc3 + BIOS 6.1.0; capturing IPMI + fan telemetry. Sharing logs in 20.

ops-bot: Incident alert created: INC-2026-0317-4123; severity P2; impacted: eu-west GPU pool. Links: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0317-4123

mira: quick note — avoid mass BIOS reboots until we confirm the fan calibration fix. We'll coordinate with hw-team for a firmware tweak to the fan controller thresholds.

alex: timeline: if rollback and controller patch done within 3h, bring capacity back to baseline in ~4-6h. If not, we'll scale cross-region and escalate to infra leadership for faster BIOS/BMC patch.

john: tagging hw-team @lei, and security @sam for the secure-boot repro case. Keep updates in this thread.

mira: update 2086543300 — canary rollback succeeded on 3 hosts, they came back online and joined the pool. Two remaining still failing; investigating edge-case with a NIC airflow sensor misreporting.

sam: controller patch merged to staging; will deploy to prod in 15 unless we see objections.

alex: cost note recorded in the incident doc — possible uplift up to $7k/mo if we carry cross-region capacity for a week.

mira: update 2086543399 — three more recovered after manual fan calibration reset via IPMI. Total affected reduced to 6 GPUs pending hw patch. Closing immediate incident actions; leaving follow-up for permanent BMC firmware update and BIOS compatibility testing. :white_check_mark:
